in_sanskrit.name: मनोधर्म
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The inherent moral code or duty of one's mind.

in_hindi.name: मनोधर्म
in_hindi.long_meaning: मन का स्वभाविक नैतिक कोड या कर्तव्य

in_marathi.name: Manodharma
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The Ego or Mind Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manodharma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two Sanskrit words, manas (mind) and dharma (duty, nature, law). Manodharma signifies the ego or mind power.

in_bengali.name: Manodharma
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ The Ego or Mind Power
in_bengali.long_meaning: Manodharma একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from two Sanskrit words, manas (mind) and dharma (duty, nature, law). Manodharma signifies the ego or mind power.
